Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning medical care for persons who are incarcerated.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to medical care for incarcerated individuals; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that determining thefinancial responsibility for individuals incarcerated in city andcounty correctional facilities is a complex process that involves manyfactors.
